title: A lane can boot or hold one simulator under a grant, tap and screenshot it, and wait for its GO
why: No route keeps an iPhone simulator booted for a lane: a guard refuses `xcrun simctl boot`; `sim-test --hold` runs only in the foreground, and the worktree guard refuses it in the background; xcodebuild and the iOS Simulator tool boot no shut-down device; hooks refuse a sleep loop, a polling Monitor and a stream follower, so no lane can wait on the gatekeeper's grants file and the gatekeeper sends each GO by hand (it pauses after 10 sends). Harm: Home PR 576 merged with its Offline and held-tall screens unchecked on a device; Duo 1 sat idle overnight Nov 7. Done when: a lane boots or holds one simulator under a gatekeeper grant, taps and screenshots it, and waits for its GO, with no guard refusal. Home coordinator hand-off, relayed by the owner as ask ask-mw839r77zp (11:11 CST Nov 8; Home notes, PR 581). The owner is unsure all still hold, so the lane checks first.
note: Coordinator 11:16 CST Nov 8: lane started. Coordinator 13:00 CST Nov 8: #2231 handed. Route when closed: `sim-test --hold --for 900` through the Monitor tool; the holding line is the GO event. Mac-only proof owed (PR body): the hold line shows in Monitor, MCP launch passes, tap and screenshot work, stop or expiry cleans up.
